steps.en: Clone SAG and start the local application
steps.zh: 克隆 SAG 并启动本地应用

steps.en: Create a local identity and configure generation and embedding models
steps.zh: 创建本地身份，配置生成与向量模型

steps.en: Create a source and upload your documents
Parse, index and extract knowledge in background jobs until Ready
steps.zh: 后台解析、索引和抽取知识，直到就绪

steps.en: Select sources and ask a question in Precise mode
steps.zh: 选择信源，在精确模式提问

steps.en: Expand and rank event candidates, then retrieve original chunks
steps.zh: 扩展并排序事项候选，再取回原文块

steps.en: Return a grounded answer with clickable source citations
steps.zh: 返回有依据的回答和可点开的原文引用

value.en: One uploaded corpus supports linked evidence search and cited answers without building a retrieval UI
value.zh: 上传一次资料即可关联检索和引用问答，不必自建检索界面
